title: Meridian Credit Policy Section 5.2 - Income Types and Shading Rules
content:
## Section 5.2 - Income Types and Shading Rules
Meridian assesses income differently depending on source and stability.

### PAYG income
- Base PAYG income may be used at 100% where continuity is established and verification is satisfactory.
- Variable income components are only used where policy conditions are met.

### Self-employed income
For self-employed applicants, the bank must assess sustainable income using the documented earnings history rather than a single-year high watermark.

Standard treatment:
- use the most recent two years of verified taxable income
- average the two years unless there is a policy-approved basis to use a lower figure
- allowable non-cash add-backs such as depreciation and amortisation may be added back where clearly evidenced
- temporary or unsupported business benefits are not to be treated as assessable income

The result of this assessment is the applicant's assessed income for servicing and DTI purposes.
